lines.en: I knock on Yumi’s door, knowing well that she likely won’t respond.
But, on the off chance that she confuses me for a delivery man or something, maybe I’ll get to spend some time with her after all.
Even if it’s only for a few seconds...
: Who is it?
: Uhh...delivery for Yumi Yamaguchi?
: You think I don’t recognize your voice, douchebag?
: I’m sorry miss, you must have me confused for someone else.
: Yeah? Then what are you delivering?
: A...pizza?
: I didn’t order a fucking pizza.
: Someone must have ordered it for you.
Yumi slams her foot or her fist or something against the door, shaking the walls of the entire dorm.
Weird. This place seems relatively new. Is the anger of a[school]-delinquent really enough to send it spiraling into disrepair?
: Listen up, asshole. I don’t know what makes you think I’m going to let you in my room, but if you don’t leave right now, I’m calling the cops.
: You threaten to call the cops pretty much every time we associate and haven’t done it yet. I’m going to take my chances.
: Well...that’s just because I hate cops just as much as you! Fucking pigs can all get bent for all I care.
I have no idea how she hasn’t noticed this exchange, yet...
: Can you at least open the door? I’m starting to feel kind of uncomfortable out here.
Yumi aggressively storms her way out of the room and grabs the collar of my shirt.
: Just fucking...come with me if you need to talk to me that desperately. I don’t want people to think the two of us are friends.
: Won’t it also look weird if you’re dragging me through the halls?
: Are you fucking coming or not?!
Yumi lets go of my shirt and storms down the hallway. I’m left with no choice but to follow after her...
I wind up following Yumi several blocks away to a small shopping plaza that has already shut down for the night.
She comes to an abrupt stop in front of a restaurant, scans the area to make sure no one is around, and then proceeds to scream at me because she is Yumi and that is what she does.
: What do you want?!
The ska music starts playing again.
: Just wanted to see if you were in the mood to hang out.
: Why?!
: Because I want to spend time with you.
: Why?!
: Because...uhh...
: Sorry, what answer could I give right now that would make you the least mad at me?
: Jesus Christ, you’re out of your fucking mind.
: Didn’t you get the hint after I freaked out on you about that fucking disgusting kiss you forced on me?
: I don’t want to be around you. Ever.
: Then why didn't you just stay in your dorm?
: Because I didn’t want fuckin’ Chika or somebody else thinkin’ that we actually spend time together! Is that really so hard to believe?!
: Isn’t it enough for you that you’re already fucking like...half the girls in our class?
: Jesus, I wouldn’t even be surprised if you had your fucking [niece] groomed already.
To be fair, Ami doesn't really require much...grooming.
: I’m not ‘fucking half the class,’ Yumi...If I was, do you really think I’d be spending my time trying to talk to you?
: I don’t fucking know. Probably?
: Don’t guys think of girls like fuckin’ trophies or whatever? That’s how it’s always seemed to me, at least.
: What do you mean by that?
: I’ve just been hangin’ around mostly guys for years now and all they ever talk about is girls and shit. It’s annoying as fuck.
Oh, right. I forgot that was a thing.
: Do you have any female friends other than Chika?
: Why does it fucking matter what kinds of friends I have? Why do you want to know?
: I just think it sounds kind of lonely not really having anyone to talk to.
: And I think it's time for you to mind your own fucking business!
: I’m perfectly fine on my own. Always have been, always will be.
: Besides, why the fuck would some random ass dudes vanishing make shit any worse for me? If anything, life’s gotten kinda easier since they've been gone.
: Don’t gotta worry about all the bullshit like how I should be more ‘girly’ or whatever. Fuck that. I’ll be however I wanna be.
: Good. More power to you.
: Just don’t go causing too much trouble. I’m pretty sure Chika doesn’t have the money to bail you out of jail if you get arrested.
: Pfft. Fuck gettin’ arrested. Ain’t no pig doin' shit about me. If they were gonna arrest me, I’d have been locked up years ago.
: For what? Picking the locks on those pachinko machines you told me about?
: Quit it with the fuckin' pachinko machines! I don't see you out there strugglin' to make a fuckin' life for yourself!
: I still don’t even get why you dragged me out here in the first place if we’re gonna just talk about which laws I break and shit!
: Are you a cop?! Because you're acting a lot like a fuckin' cop right now.
: I would be an extremely bad cop.
: Yeah, well you're an extremely bad teacher too and that hasn't stopped you.
: Listen dude, I already told you I’m not gonna fuck you. So just get the hell outta here and let me go home.
: I’m beginning to think you aren’t having fun tonight.
: I wonder if kickin’ him in the dick would give me enough time to get away...
: I can hear you, Yumi.
: Just tell me what I can do to get on better terms with you.
: Well, you could stop callin’ me to your office for one.
: Hey. I may suck at being a teacher, but I can’t just not do anything about you bullying the other girls.
: Right. Because you’re fucking them and need to keep ‘em happy so they’ll let you shove your gross-ass micropenis inside.
: Yumi, I can assure you that I do not have a micropenis.
: Whatever, doesn't mean it's not gross.
: So other than letting you bully everyone, what else can I do?
: How am I supposed to know? I can’t just fuckin’ decide to like you when I’ve gotten so used to treatin’ you like this.
: Specially not with all the shit you've done to me.
: People don’t just fuckin' change overnight, man. You’re not some...magical fucking exception to that.
I beg to differ, but I'm not about to unload my weird circumstances onto Yumi when even I don't understand them yet.
: I know that people don’t change overnight. But I’ve been following you around for weeks now trying to get to know you.
: Right. And you also almost pushed me over a goddamn guardrail while mouth-[raping] me. Real good job of gettin’ to know me.
: Weird things keep happening in that part of town.
: And while I know that isn't an excuse, it-
: No, I'm calling bullshit. That is an excuse.
: I’m not gonna fuckin' believe that you just...turn into somebody else based on what part of the city you're in. Get real.
: Again, I’m sorry about that. Something...came over me.
: Yeah, it’s called a fuckin’ hard-on. Learn to control yourself.
: All I’m saying is that I think you wouldn’t hate me so much if you tried to talk to me without insulting me every once in a while.
: Impossible. Just seeing you makes me feel sick to my stomach.
: Are you sure you aren’t in love with me? That could also cause you to feel a little-
: In LOVE with you?! Are you fucking drunk?!
: No. I actually chose to visit the dorms instead of the bar tonight.
: Well it sure fuckin’ sounds like you are! I don’t give a shit about love or feelings or ANY of that fucking nonsense!
: That kinda shit is for Chika! You wanna hang around a girl who’s actually got a chance to fall for you? Hit her up. Not me.
: And shit, dude. For all I know, you could be fucking her already as well. God knows it might get her to fuckin' relax a little.
I can...definitely see myself doing that soon enough. But there are other issues at hand here.
: Yumi, I can promise you now that I have not fucked your roommate.
: Yumi, I can promise you now that I have not fucked your roommate.
: Whatever. Not like I fucking care since I know you want to.
: At least she’s smart enough to not let some assclown like you screw her over.
: Chika woulda cut your fuckin’ head off if you were to pull the same kinda shit you pulled with me.
In a rare moment of what seems like vulnerability, Yumi puts herself down in favor of Chika.
But why?
: Are you saying that Chika is stronger than you?
: That’s absolutely not what I fuckin’ said...
: I’d kick Chika's ass in a fight, but that's not what this is about.
: She deals with shit much differently than I do. She’s always doin’ things head-on and I’m-
: ...tch. Who the fuck even knows? Not like it matters.
: You sure you don’t want to go on with that? It sounded like you were going to finally start opening up to me for a second.
: Heh. Dream on, asshole. That’s already more than you were supposed to get tonight.
: You’re lucky I pitied you enough to follow you out here.
Does she really not remember that she's the one who led me?...
: Yup. Sure am. That’s why I’m not going to push you any further tonight.
: You’ll come around to me eventually. I think I just need to keep annoying you until you break.
: It’s gonna take a lot more than just followin’ me around to break me, you know? I’m not like the girls you spend most of your time with.
: Exactly. Which is one of the many reasons I’m trying to get closer to you.
: Well, as long as none of those reasons are turning me into your pet or whatever the fuck you’re doing to all those girls-
: I guess there are...worse things out there.
: You’re still a little bitch, though. And I’ll cut your fucking dick off if you kiss me again.
: Understood...
I know that Yumi acts tough all the time...but it seems like she might actually be pretty vulnerable at the end of the day.
I just wonder what made her like that.
Or what makes her like that.
I want to know more.
Yumi’s affection has somehow increased to [yumi_love]!
